reproduced_defects.description: Mission Realm back navigation exposes Login screen when user is authenticated.
reproduced_defects.pre_fix_reproduction: Navigating back popped the route stack and exposed Login screen below Mission Realm.
reproduced_defects.root_cause: PopScope was allowing pop to unauthenticated Login route without checking active mission state.
reproduced_defects.fix: PopScope(canPop: false), header back button replaced with clean Logout action, preventing pop to unauthenticated routes.

reproduced_defects.description: Re-login with same authenticated email shows Central Exams = 0, State/UT Exams = 0 until hot restart.
reproduced_defects.pre_fix_reproduction: Logging out and logging back in left recruitmentsProvider in closed/stale stream state.
reproduced_defects.root_cause: recruitmentsProvider was non-autoDispose StreamProvider that did not re-subscribe on authState transition.
reproduced_defects.fix: Converted recruitmentsProvider to autoDispose and explicitly watched authStateChangesProvider to re-hydrate catalog on login.

reproduced_defects.description: Dashboard card names/titles are too dull; secondary Pending values dominate visually.
reproduced_defects.pre_fix_reproduction: Card titles lacked weight and brand color hierarchy compared to status badges.
reproduced_defects.root_cause: Style hierarchy gave equal visual weight to status badges and metric titles.
reproduced_defects.fix: Strengthened metric titles (READINESS, COVERAGE, STREAK, RISK) with gold brand tint, bold weight, and letter spacing; muted secondary status.

reproduced_defects.description: Dashboard displays fake 4% readiness baseline when user has 0 preparation evidence.
reproduced_defects.pre_fix_reproduction: Dashboard readiness card displayed 4% for fresh accounts with no completed items.
reproduced_defects.root_cause: ReadinessEngine.calculate contained fallback formula ((100 - risk) * 0.10) where (100 - 60) * 0.10 = 4.0%.
reproduced_defects.fix: Removed synthetic formula. When preparation evidence is 0, score returns 0.0 and status returns 'Pending Evidence'.

reproduced_defects.description: DigiBook and Crucible surfaces exposed fabricated demo content/progress.
reproduced_defects.pre_fix_reproduction: DigiBook rendered sample chapters and Crucible rendered synthetic 98-day protocol progress without real backend backing.
reproduced_defects.root_cause: Fallback mock/demo generators were active in production consumer lanes.
reproduced_defects.fix: Replaced fake synthetic state generators with truthful Preparing / Empty state widgets.

reproduced_defects.description: Previously visible JEE Main academic syllabus data disappeared from student view.
reproduced_defects.pre_fix_reproduction: JEE Main syllabus tree was empty despite Firestore having nodes.
reproduced_defects.root_cause: KnowledgeEngine.dart filtered nodes strictly with isPaper1 = (paperId == 'PAPER_1'), dropping nodes with null/empty/lowercase paper IDs.
reproduced_defects.fix: Loosened paper filter to accept empty, null, and case-insensitive canonical variations.

reproduced_defects.description: Report and code referenced non-canonical DH code for Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.
reproduced_defects.pre_fix_reproduction: DH was referenced in code and fixtures.
reproduced_defects.root_cause: Legacy code confusion between old single Dadra & Nagar Haveli code and merged UT canonical code.
reproduced_defects.fix: Replaced DH with canonical ISO 3166-2:IN code DN in IndiaStates and all validation rules.
